verdict.rationale: Convertio's web UI accepts multiple files in one drop-and-convert action, and it documents a CLI and unlimited concurrent conversions. Nothing in the evidence shows folder-level batch conversion or per-file result reporting. missing for 10: documented folder or list batch conversion in one run, per-file success/failure results, CLI batch usage docs, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can convert a whole folder or list of files in one run, with per-file results

citations.quote: Just drop your files on the page, choose an output format and click "Convert" button.
